text:
Register entry for the construct 'approx(<N>)'.
Meaning: approx(N) = approximately N; the value is an estimate, not an exact measurement.
Slot: approx( = the enclosed value is an approximation
Example: deploy takes approx(5) min; approx(99) percent bots; latency was approx(5) ms then approx(10) ms.
In careful English: deploy takes approximately 5 minutes; approximately 99 percent bots; latency was approximately 5ms then approximately 10ms.
